summary: Completed comprehensive testing of The Culinary Editorial F&B e-commerce template. All 8 pages tested (Home, Menu, Product Detail, Checkout, Admin, Orders, Loyalty, Kitchen). Backend APIs (10 endpoints) all passing. Frontend UI fully functional with correct design implementation.

issues: Footer is visible on checkout page - may want to hide it for cleaner checkout experience (minor)
Footer is visible on admin page - may want to hide it for admin dashboard (minor)

critical_code_review_comments: All pages use static placeholder data as expected for skeleton template
Navbar correctly hides on /checkout and /admin routes
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Design colors match requirements: off-white bg (#F8F5F0), dark maroon primary, orange accent (#E55A3D)
Fonts correctly implemented: Cormorant Garamond for headings, Manrope for body
seed_data_creation: None - template uses static placeholder data
